rationale: Since entry the stock has coiled in a 5-cent range while holding above rising VWAP ($31.82) and the 9-EMA, printing rising 1-minute lows (31.87 → 31.89 → 31.91 → 31.93) with the heaviest volume on up-moves and near-total dry-up on pullbacks — supply still absorbed, original thesis intact and invalidation at $31.70 untouched. Shorting into a 51x-RVOL uptrend pressing the offer at $31.94 lacks evidentiary support, and closing for a scratch forfeits a still-defined ~2x asymmetry with only ~$86 at risk. The modest confidence reflects 21 minutes without range expansion and the still-weak tape rather than any deterioration in the setup.
